slides.headline: 5 things you probably missed this week
slides.subline: **Central banks, hackers and a storm.** The quick version.

slides.body: Spain's **Pablo Hernández de Cos** was picked to succeed Christine Lagarde as [[European Central Bank]] president, the NYT and FT report.
**FIFA** confirmed a cyberattack that accessed [[personal and business information]], DW and BBC report.
France's **AFP** news agency was hit by a [[cyberattack]] and took its content platform offline, Al Jazeera and Anadolu report.
A **Thanksgiving storm** left nearly [[a million]] people without power across the US, with flooding and flight delays.
Mexico wants talks with the US about suspected **SpaceX rocket debris** washing up on its coast, Al Jazeera and Yahoo Finance report.
Which of these surprised you most? Tell us below.
